2. Network Performance Issues

OneStream System Errors

Description
When importing or validating data, users may see a message like “The system cannot find the file specified,” or the import may freeze halfway. This typically happens when internet connectivity is weak, unstable, or interrupted.

chunk-8af938d88e1d92c810317b41dd75f14f.content:
Root Cause
OneStream is a cloud-based application, so every data transfer relies on your internet connection. If you are on unstable Wi-Fi, connected to a slow VPN, or using a network with insufficient bandwidth, OneStream will lose its connection during file transfer. Even a small drop in connection can cause the system to fail to find or process your file.

How to Solve

Check that your internet connection is stable by opening other websites.

chunk-978048478f3c25ba13ac704f6f6775ca.content:
How to Solve

Check that your internet connection is stable by opening other websites.

If using Wi-Fi, try moving closer to the router or switch to a wired connection.

Close other programs that use heavy bandwidth such as video calls or streaming.

Retry the import or validation.

If the error repeats, submit IT support ticket.

Missing Mapping Error-Mapping Error

Description
During validation, OneStream may stop and show “Target value missing.” This means that the system does not know how to map a value from the source file to a valid OneStream member. Users may think their file is wrong, but often it is because a new account or dimension value hasn’t been mapped yet.

chunk-7c686046d60abc94ecd48dc9fcb9279e.content:
Root Cause
Mapping rules (called Transformation Rules) must cover every possible source value. If a new account was added in SAP or Dynamics but not in OneStream, validation fails. Even if the value exists, differences in formatting (leading zeros, spaces, or letter case) can cause a mismatch. Another possibility is that the mapping exists only in a regional table, but the workflow is pointing to a common table.

How to Solve

chunk-cd1397725188cf9637d6442d0c5e89f0.content:
How to Solve

Look at the validation error and note the exact source value missing.

Go to Application → Transformation Rules and search for it.

If the value is not found, raise a mapping request with details: value, description, and intended target.

If it exists but looks different, adjust the file or request a mapping fix.

If it exists but still fails, check whether your workflow is using the right Rule Profile (regional vs. common).

chunk-9a18c3e1c2bbe691cf689c00b9522b1d.content:
If it exists but looks different, adjust the file or request a mapping fix.

If it exists but still fails, check whether your workflow is using the right Rule Profile (regional vs. common).

After the mapping is corrected, reload and validate again.

Each account in OneStream has rules for which UD (user-defined) members are allowed. If the file or mapping produces an invalid combination, validation fails.

If the mapping created the wrong combination, escalate to OS support for a fix.

6. Conditional Mapping Error - Mapping Error

Description
Validation may show errors when some required dimension combinations are missing. For example, if an Intercompany Partner is given without UD4 (business line), the system will reject the row.

chunk-f6b60420ea1af607508cb6e918ae83d8.content:
Root Cause
OneStream enforces dimension combinations. If one is present but its required partner is missing or invalid, the record cannot pass validation.

How to Solve

Read the error message carefully to identify the missing dimension.

Open your source file to check whether the dimension was provided.

If it was not, add it and reload.

If it should have been mapped automatically, check Transformation Rules or escalate to OS team.

Re-run validation.

Description
When logging into OneStream, users sometimes receive an error that says:

chunk-40bb20380c8b404567120c05e612b932.content:
Token / Time Synchronization Error (IDX10222) – OneStream System

Description
When logging into OneStream, users sometimes receive an error that says:

IDX10222: Lifetime validation failed. The token is not yet valid.
This stops the user from logging in and blocks access to the system completely. For less experienced users, this error often looks like a complicated technical failure, but in reality, it is usually a simple clock setting issue.

chunk-4a57c6b9afbd15940a292bd5d99564c9.content:
Root Cause
OneStream relies on secure authentication tokens, which are time-sensitive. If the local computer’s system clock is out of sync with the server time, the token will not be considered valid. Even a few minutes’ difference can sometimes cause the system to reject the login, but often the issue comes from a computer being hours behind or ahead. This is common if automatic time updates are turned off or if the machine was disconnected from the internet for a long time.

How to Solve

chunk-f7f61d30a0ba8c3e8f0c330fd9e6d495.content:
How to Solve

On your computer, open the Date and Time settings.

Make sure “Set time automatically” and “Set time zone automatically” are enabled.

If they are not, turn them on, or manually adjust the time to match the correct local time.

If needed, enable Internet Time synchronization so your computer clock updates from a server regularly.

Restart OneStream and try logging in again.

chunk-ce0780d24064345ea48452ca4fdab2ad.content:
If needed, enable Internet Time synchronization so your computer clock updates from a server regularly.

Restart OneStream and try logging in again.

If multiple users in the same entity experience the same issue, escalate to IT — this may mean your company’s domain controllers are not synchronizing time properly.
